confirmation_sample: first quota rows by selection_hash from the latest-season stratum of the frozen GOLD1000_R1 reserve manifest

development_split.calibration: chronological first half of middle season in each competition
development_split.policy_selection: chronological second half of middle season in each competition
development_split.diagnostic_test: latest season of development sample; never used for model or threshold selection

confirmation_rule: latest-season reserve matches only; no model or threshold selection may use confirmation labels
feature_set: market close structural features plus existing PIT and P0 features; no current-match event statistics
probability_calibration: Platt calibration fitted only on the calibration subset; stacked_logit uses the calibration subset as its fixed meta-training set

conservative.constraints: policy coverage <= 0.15, precision >= 0.40, complete-1X2 accuracy delta >= -0.01
conservative.objective: maximize policy Draw F1; tie-break precision then lower coverage

balanced.constraints: policy coverage <= 0.25, precision >= 0.35, complete-1X2 accuracy delta >= -0.02
balanced.objective: maximize policy Draw F1; tie-break recall then precision

recall.constraints: policy coverage <= 0.40, precision >= 0.30, complete-1X2 accuracy delta >= -0.04
recall.objective: maximize policy Draw recall; tie-break F1 then precision

risk_control.constraints: policy coverage <= 0.30, selected >= 15, 90% Wilson lower precision bound >= 0.30, complete-1X2 accuracy delta >= -0.03
risk_control.objective: maximize policy coverage; tie-break precision then F1

bootstrap: 1000 competition-cluster bootstrap replicates with 90% percentile intervals
hard_boundaries: no confirmation-label model or threshold selection
